reviews.review_description:
First thing you do is scan your room. It only takes a few seconds, just look around at all the corners. Make sure your room isn’t huge, because the game gets harder because you have to run from one side to the other nonstop.

Then you place a structure which is what the enemy will go for. After placing it, a path is drawn a path for the enemies to follow. Your job is to stop them from reaching the base, the Neurogate. The defenses are turrets. There are only two in this demo, but it looks like the full game will have a bunch more types. To build them you need a resource that drops from the ceiling, yellow pieces called memory. The more memory you grab, the more turrets you can place, and the tougher it gets for the enemies.

Every now and then, missiles show up and you have to intercept them with your hands because they are aiming at your turrets. Sounds easy? It is, but you are constantly moving, building turrets nonstop and catching missiles, so you do not get a single break. It is super fun, but you need to be in a relative good  shape.
